hardware.card_index_note: rocm-smi GPU[1] == drm card0 == PCI 0000:10:00.0 == the RX 7900 XTX. This matches the historical 2026-08-15 soak artifact, which sampled /sys/class/drm/card0/device/mem_info_vram_used on this same card, so the historical sampler path still targets the XTX today. Ordinals alone are not trusted: capacity probes must resolve the card by pci_id 0000:10:00.0 via hipengine.util.amdgpu_vram.select_card and record unique_id.
